Card Q&A.a: It refers to when a card has as many or more total colors than the number specified.
Card Q&A.q: What does "X or more total colors" mean, exactly?

My opponent has a Digimon with 10000 DP or more, or my Tamers have 3 or more total colors. Can I activate this card's [Your Turn] effect at the same time as an effect such as P-108 [Wisdom Training]'s effect that digivolves?

Effect: [Your Turn] While your opponent has a Digimon with 10000 DP or more, or your Tamers have 3 or more total colors, this Digimon can digivolve into [MetalGarurumon] in the hand for a digivolution cost of 4, ignoring digivolution requirements.
Inherited Effect: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] ＜Draw 1＞. (Draw 1 card from your deck.) Then, trash 1 card in your hand.
